parts.text: Regenerate the truth-reader implementation from the prior array-projection design with this correction as authoritative. Per-document reader provenance belongs in the existing GeminiSupervisor dependency list/map and must be updated by the existing dependency-sync mechanism, not maintained as an independent competing provenance system. Extend ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json so every canonical document eligible for truth reading can declare its stable reader path plus source-specific provenance fields, including current canonical source blob SHA and the last commit SHA that changed that source path. Extend .github/workflows/gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml and any deterministic helper code as needed so when a mapped canonical document changes, the dependency-sync mechanism mechanically regenerates that document's stable ordered-array reader from the COMPLETE canonical source and updates that entry's provenance. Unrelated repository commits must not rewrite the reader or its provenance. Do not use Gemini to construct reader contents or provenance; this part is deterministic Node/git logic. The truth-reader challenge workflow must consume this dependency-map provenance rather than independently rediscovering/rebuilding stable readers. Before seeding, require the stable reader provenance to match the dependency-map provenance; if it does, reuse it. If it does not, treat that as a dependency-sync failure/blocking condition rather than silently rebuilding through the challenge workflow. Stable readers are ordered JSON arrays containing the complete canonical content. Truth seeds are separate array elements inserted only into ephemeral active projections at deterministic distributed intervals. Worker returns every seed in active projection order; exact complete match is truth PASS. Keep enumerated selector booleans, workflow-only CSPRNG authority, separate evidence file, zero mutation on FAIL, and atomic PASS cleanup of active projections/evidence/selector without rewriting unchanged stable readers. Return response_type truth_reader_implementation with files[] containing exact repository paths and COMPLETE contents for every required changed/new file, including dependency-map.json, gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml, deterministic helper/engine code, selector/evidence/status/catalog surfaces, and stable/active reader files as required.
